platoon_reachability_rank.solver_status_note: OPTIMAL termination and FEASIBLE_POINT primal are solver-reported statuses, not mathematical strict-feasibility guarantees

largest_sos_block.reported_wall_time: about 0.20 s each for the two order-4 propagation blocks

one_node_comparison.family: z_alpha = alpha z1 + (1-alpha) z2, alpha in [0,1]
one_node_comparison.scope: specified convex-projection family only; unrestricted one-node certificates are not excluded

software_environment.solver_license: licensed MOSEK installation required for the platoon SOS verifier

acceptance_policy: exact rational or symbolic verification for solver-free claims
termination status OPTIMAL for every reported numerical SOS block
primal status FEASIBLE_POINT for every reported numerical SOS block
solver statuses are not mathematical strict-feasibility guarantees
SLOW_PROGRESS and ALMOST_OPTIMAL are never accepted as certificates
